body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> IXT presented its new DVD karaoke microphone converter during 2007 CES Unveiled.

According to the company, its patent pending DVD microphone converts any DVD player and TV into a karaoke system. If you connect the M201 to any DVD player audio-out ports and TV audio-in ports, it allows you to have your voice mixed with the music being played from any DVD, CD or music video.

In other words, you can have a convenient karaoke system with which you can sing-a-long immediately. It could be useful for moms or in a nursery home for education purpose or any other entertainment-use, a company official claimed.
